project.name: mesh_rag
project.description: Mesh-RAG demo (Ditto × Cactus, iOS + Android). Two phones each hold a slice of a study-notes corpus; they meet over BLE/Wi-Fi and the vector index merges as a CRDT.

nodes.name: demo-script.md
nodes.summary: Rehearsable end-to-end script for Holdout 1's airplane-mode demo: pre-flight checklist, beat-by-beat narration, and recovery branches for the two-phone Mesh RAG showcase.

nodes.name: IDEA-A.md
nodes.summary: The load-bearing idea document — frames the writeup thesis 'Your knowledge base wants to be a CRDT' and pins Mesh RAG as the chosen framing among brainstorm options A through D.

nodes.name: cactus-sdk-quirks.md
nodes.summary: Engineering catalogue of Cactus 1.3.0 Flutter SDK behaviors the demo had to work around — including the Supabase telemetry call that pierces airplane-mode and the model-download path that ignores telemetry flags.

nodes.name: model-quirks.md
nodes.summary: Running catalogue of Qwen 2.5 1.7B on-device quirks (bilingual chain-of-thought drift, fabricated outputs, grounding-prompt rationalization) used as evidence in the specialists-vs-generalists writeup thread.

nodes.name: thesis-framings.md
nodes.summary: Stress-test memo resolving SEED.md Q4 — carries each candidate framing at 250 words, names the strongest skeptic for each, and picks the framing the writeup will lead with.

nodes.name: 001-feat-mesh-rag-demo.md
nodes.summary: Authoritative implementation plan for the Mesh RAG demo — defines implementation units (U1..U14), holdout coverage, scope boundaries, and per-source citations into the 281-source research index.

nodes.name: r5-pre-baked-embeddings.md
nodes.summary: Engineering memo identifying that per-note Cactus embedding backfill (78% of cold-load time) is R5's missing lever — proposes shipping embedding bytes inside the seed JSON to bypass on-device inference.

nodes.name: RESEARCH-BRIEF.md
nodes.summary: Brief handed to deep-research agents — defines project summary, six research tasks (frameworks, embeddings, LLMs, CRDTs, mesh sync, latency framing), and the required deliverables format.

nodes.name: chatgpt-deep-research.md
nodes.summary: Hosted ChatGPT Deep Research pass — sourcing-first memo establishing Ditto as well-supported synchronization substrate and framing cross-device embedding determinism as a validation objective rather than baseline assumption.

nodes.name: claude-deep-research.md
nodes.summary: Hosted Claude Deep Research pass — synthesizes evidence for CPU-only embedding determinism, identifies P2P RAG prior art (DRAG, DGRAG), and pins latency as the durable thesis with concrete numbers.

nodes.name: claude.md
nodes.summary: Mode-B parallel worker output from Claude — top-10 must-read sources plus per-topic findings, framed toward the recipes-then-cars corpus and the small-specialist-models future-work angle.

nodes.name: codex.md
nodes.summary: Mode-B parallel worker output from Codex — primary-source-first survey covering Cactus, Ditto, PyTorch reproducibility, and the official Ditto sync/mesh-networking concepts.

nodes.name: downloads.yaml
nodes.summary: Canonical manifest of every research source downloaded into _inspiration/ — 281 entries with URL, kind, title, citing worker(s), download status, and local path; drives the research-indexer pipeline.
nodes.languageNotes: Single-document YAML with a flat entries[] list of ~280 source records — append-only manifest produced by the researcher skill.

nodes.name: gemini-deep-research.md
nodes.summary: Hosted Gemini Deep Research pass — architectural foundations memo emphasizing Valori fixed-point determinism, inference-backend reproducibility risk, and Ditto delta-state CRDT documentation.

nodes.name: gemini.md
nodes.summary: Mode-B parallel worker output from Gemini — compact top-10 + per-topic findings emphasizing the local-first manifesto, Cactus bit-identical kernels, and Ink & Switch malleable-software framing.

nodes.name: by-tag.md
nodes.summary: Inverted tag index — 1192 distinct tags mapped to source IDs across all 281 per-source summaries, sorted by density, supporting wide-net tag-driven discovery.

nodes.name: by-topic.md
nodes.summary: Macro-topic grouping of the research corpus into 13 buckets aligned with SEED.md and RESEARCH-BRIEF.md tasks (on-device inference, embeddings, CRDTs, mesh sync, determinism, etc.).

nodes.name: clusters.md
nodes.summary: Thirteen thematic research narratives (case for on-device, Ditto stack, Cactus+LLM, determinism, specialists, etc.) — each cluster carries a story-shaped narrative tying its sources together.

nodes.name: cross-references.md
nodes.summary: Directed citation graph extracted from every per-source file — 541 edges across 230 sourceful nodes, with a most-cited ranking that surfaces the foundational sources of the corpus.

nodes.name: open-questions.md
nodes.summary: Gaps the 281-source corpus does not answer — empirical open questions tied to Stage 0 holdouts plus the four-thread future-work arc (specialists, preference-aware merge, adversarial filtering, generational evolution) the writeup should land on.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Entry point for the research index — guides a downstream coding agent to start at top-N.md and branch by intent, with a density legend and pointers to clusters, by-topic, by-tag, cross-references, and open-questions.

nodes.name: top-N.md
nodes.summary: Twenty-two highest-density sources ranked with one-paragraph annotations — ~45 minutes of mandatory reading before designing anything in the Mesh RAG demo.

nodes.name: SEED.md
nodes.summary: Validation harness for agentic development — defines holdout scenarios R1 through R11, threat-model bound, cut order, and the Validation → Feedback loop the implementation runs through.

nodes.name: WEB-PROMPT.md
nodes.summary: Hosted deep-research prompt that briefs Claude.ai / ChatGPT / Gemini DR workers on the Mesh RAG thesis, holdouts, and the eight research-task tracks (determinism, CRDT vector indexes, mesh sync, on-device LLM/embeddings, local-first prior art, latency moats, demo aesthetics).

nodes.name: ci.yml
nodes.summary: GitHub Actions workflow that runs `just ci` (flutter analyze + test) on push to main and on pull requests, pinning Flutter 3.32.0 stable to match the local puro provisioned version so CI-green and local-green are bitwise the same set of checks.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses concurrency group with cancel-in-progress to drop superseded runs on the same ref.

nodes.name: .understandignore
nodes.summary: Ignore-file for the Understand-Anything code-graph tool, scoping the knowledge-graph build to load-bearing source while skipping bulky research artifacts, build outputs, and per-source summaries.

nodes.name: analysis_options.yaml
nodes.summary: Dart analyzer configuration that pulls in flutter_lints recommended ruleset for the Mesh RAG Flutter project.

nodes.name: build.gradle.kts
nodes.summary: Android app module Gradle script that applies the Flutter, Android, and Kotlin plugins, pins NDK 27.0.12077973 (required by Cactus + ditto_live + record + permission_handler), sets minSdk 24, and targets Java 11.
nodes.languageNotes: NDK version is pinned identically to tools/determinism_harness/ to avoid manifest-merger conflicts.

nodes.name: AndroidManifest.xml (debug)
nodes.summary: Debug-variant Android manifest overlay; typically enables cleartext traffic and the Flutter dev tools socket while keeping the main manifest's BLE/Wi-Fi permission stack inherited from ditto_live.

nodes.name: AndroidManifest.xml
nodes.summary: Primary Android manifest declaring the MainActivity launch theme, intent filters, and PROCESS_TEXT query. BLE/Wi-Fi peer-to-peer permissions are intentionally NOT re-declared here — they are contributed by ditto_live's bundled manifest to avoid maxSdkVersion merger conflicts.
nodes.languageNotes: Trusts the transitive BLUETOOTH_*/NEARBY_WIFI_DEVICES declarations from ditto_live rather than re-declaring them.

nodes.name: MainActivity.kt
nodes.summary: Android entry-point Activity for the Mesh RAG Flutter app; a thin subclass of FlutterActivity that defers all hosting work to the Flutter engine.

nodes.name: launch_background.xml (v21)
nodes.summary: API 21+ launch-background drawable shown by the Android process between activity start and Flutter engine warmup; ensures a consistent splash backdrop before the Dart side renders.

nodes.name: launch_background.xml
nodes.summary: Default launch-background drawable used by the Android process before the Flutter engine takes over rendering.

nodes.name: styles.xml (night)
nodes.summary: Dark-mode style resources defining LaunchTheme and NormalTheme used between Android process start and Flutter engine takeover.

nodes.name: styles.xml
nodes.summary: Default style resources defining LaunchTheme and NormalTheme that bridge the visible UI state between Android process start and the first Flutter frame.

nodes.name: AndroidManifest.xml (profile)
nodes.summary: Profile-variant Android manifest overlay used by `flutter run --profile`; typically mirrors debug for network/dev-tools access while keeping release-like compilation.

nodes.name: build.gradle.kts (root)
nodes.summary: Top-level Android Gradle script configuring the project-wide build directory layout and the standard Flutter `evaluationDependsOn(':app')` ordering.

nodes.name: gradle.properties
nodes.summary: Android Gradle properties tuning the JVM args and toggling AndroidX support for the Flutter build.

nodes.name: gradle-wrapper.properties
nodes.summary: Pins the Gradle distribution URL and version used by the wrapper so the Android build is reproducible across machines.

nodes.name: settings.gradle.kts
nodes.summary: Android Gradle settings script that wires in the Flutter loader, the Android Gradle Plugin, and the Kotlin plugin via the pluginManagement block; standard Flutter-template scaffolding.

nodes.name: README.md (assets)
nodes.summary: Documents the Stage 0 seed corpus: two role-scoped JSON files (`seed_notes_a.json` for the inner solar system, `seed_notes_b.json` for the outer), the on-disk schema, the UUIDv5 idempotence trick, the contrived disjoint split for R1 legibility, and the U11 anti-hallucination grounding requirement.

nodes.name: seed_notes_a.json
nodes.summary: Phone-A seed corpus: five study notes on the Sun and the inner solar system (Mercury, Venus, Earth's Moon, Mars). Pre-embedding; embeddings backfilled at runtime by RetrievalService.ensureEmbeddings.
nodes.languageNotes: 5191-line JSON is wide-formatted prose bodies, not a deep tree; one entry per note.

nodes.name: seed_notes_b.json
nodes.summary: Phone-B seed corpus: five study notes on the outer solar system (Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune) plus Pluto. Disjoint from seed_notes_a.json by design so R1's before/after airplane-mode demo is camera-legible.
nodes.languageNotes: 5191-line JSON is wide-formatted prose bodies, not a deep tree; one entry per note.

nodes.name: CLAUDE.md
nodes.summary: Repo-level Claude Code playbook: pins the Mesh-RAG thesis-bearing constraints (cloud-not-in-trust-boundary, iOS+Android required, Holdout 7 never cut, determinism R2 pre-flight gate, study-notes corpus), describes the documentation hierarchy, and codifies jj-first VCS conventions.

nodes.name: interview.md
nodes.summary: Step 0 of the c4-design skill: structured interview capturing external actors, system boundary, containers, component-level decomposition of phone_app and determinism_harness, and resolved/deferred open questions — the source the Likec4 model.c4 is drafted from.

nodes.name: model.c4
nodes.summary: Likec4 DSL source of truth for the Mesh-RAG architecture: declares actors (demonstrator, audience contributor/querent), external systems (cactus_model_registry, peer_phone), the mesh_rag system with four containers (phone_app, cactus_models, ditto_store, determinism_harness) and all component-level relationships across UI/service/instrument layers.
nodes.languageNotes: Likec4 specification + model + views structure; views are auto-rendered into the gitignored dashboard.

nodes.name: contents.xcworkspacedata
nodes.summary: Top-level Xcode workspace descriptor that includes the Runner.xcodeproj and the Pods.xcodeproj generated by CocoaPods so Xcode opens both together.

nodes.name: IDEWorkspaceChecks.plist
nodes.summary: Xcode IDE workspace-check state for the top-level Runner.xcworkspace, suppressing the 32-bit upgrade warning on open.

nodes.name: WorkspaceSettings.xcsettings
nodes.summary: Workspace-level Xcode settings for the Runner workspace, disabling the upgrade-check dialog for the combined Runner + Pods workspace.

nodes.summary: Subclass of FlutterAppDelegate that overrides didFinishLaunchingWithOptions to register generated Flutter plugins before delegating to the superclass.

nodes.summary: App icon asset catalog manifest enumerating the icon variants (iPhone, iPad, App Store) at every required scale and idiom for iOS.

nodes.name: Contents.json
nodes.summary: Launch image asset catalog manifest mapping LaunchImage PNGs to 1x/2x/3x scales for the iOS launch screen.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Brief note explaining how to replace the launch screen images in this image set — Flutter boilerplate guidance left in place.

nodes.name: LaunchScreen.storyboard
nodes.summary: Interface Builder storyboard rendered while iOS loads the Flutter engine, displaying the LaunchImage asset on a single view controller.
nodes.languageNotes: Edited via Xcode's Interface Builder; the XML schema is opaque and not meant for hand-editing.

nodes.name: Main.storyboard
nodes.summary: Main storyboard containing the FlutterViewController shell that hosts the Flutter UI once the engine is ready.

nodes.name: Info.plist
nodes.summary: iOS application Info.plist declaring bundle metadata, supported orientations, launch storyboard, and any privacy usage strings required by Apple.

nodes.name: Runner-Bridging-Header.h
nodes.summary: Swift-Objective-C bridging header for the Runner target — currently empty, kept in place as a hook for adding ObjC imports the Swift code needs.

nodes.name: RunnerTests.swift
nodes.summary: Stub XCTest case for the Runner target left in place as a hook for native-side tests; contains only a placeholder testExample function.

nodes.name: justfile
nodes.summary: Just task runner manifest centralizing all repo workflows: C4 dashboard build, determinism harness, mesh_rag app runs (per phone role), holdout 3/4/7 runners, Ditto wipe, demo overlay flags, and seed-embedding bake/pull cycles.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses `set dotenv-load` so every recipe reads .env credentials; per-recipe `working-directory` attributes chdir for the harness subproject.

nodes.name: cold_load_timer.dart
nodes.summary: Holdout 5 (R5) cold-load instrumentation that records elapsed milliseconds at named boot-phase boundaries (Ditto init, model download, first card displayed) and emits a JSON-shaped report for the 10-second app-launch budget.
nodes.languageNotes: Idiomatic Dart singleton (`._()` + static `instance`); `@visibleForTesting` exposes `reset` and the pure `buildReport` builder so tests avoid Stopwatch flakiness.

nodes.name: ColdLoadTimer
nodes.summary: Singleton timer that tracks app-launch phases against the R5 ≤10s budget; first-mark-wins semantics keep retries from clobbering original timings, and a pure static buildReport makes the JSON shape unit-testable.

nodes.name: idempotence_check.dart
nodes.summary: Pure-function snapshot diff that verifies Holdouts R3 (sync idempotence) and R4 (bidirectional CRDT merge) over StudyNote snapshots; returns JSON-shaped verdicts consumed by the on-device runner.
nodes.languageNotes: Math-only file — never imports ditto_live so the verdict logic stays unit-testable without a BLE handshake.

nodes.name: ConvergenceResult
nodes.summary: Immutable R4 verdict bundle: union-size expectation, per-device sizes, missing-id lists, and content-diverged ids — serialized as JSON for CI consumption.

nodes.name: IdempotenceResult
nodes.summary: Immutable R3 verdict bundle: id-set adds/removes, content-changed ids, and top-k drift count for the fixture query after a re-meet.

nodes.name: IdempotenceCheck
nodes.summary: Static facade exposing detectConvergence (R4), detectIdempotence (R3), and buildReport — all pure functions over snapshots.

nodes.name: detectConvergence
nodes.summary: R4 verdict: checks both post-meet snapshots contain the full pre-meet union AND that shared-id documents are structurally equal across replicas.

nodes.name: detectIdempotence
nodes.summary: R3 verdict: detects whether a re-meet with no authoring changed the id-set, per-id content, or ordered top-k for a fixture query.

nodes.name: main.dart
nodes.summary: Application entry point; runs the cold-load instrumentation, requests mesh permissions, and drives the BootScreen state machine through Ditto/Cactus/embedding init before swapping to QueryScreen.
nodes.languageNotes: Reads PHONE_ROLE, INITIAL_TOPIC, and BAKE_EMBEDDINGS via String/bool.fromEnvironment for --dart-define-driven configuration.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Starts cold-load instrumentation early, initializes the Flutter binding, requests mesh permissions, and hands off to runApp.

nodes.name: MeshRagApp
nodes.summary: Root MaterialApp; configures Material 3 indigo theme and mounts BootScreen as the initial home.

nodes.name: BootScreen
nodes.summary: Stateful screen that walks the boot phase machine (Ditto init → sync → seed load → Cactus init → embedding backfill) and swaps in QueryScreen once ready; surfaces typed failure when PHONE_ROLE is unset.

nodes.name: study_note.dart
nodes.summary: Canonical StudyNote shape — the G-Set unit synced by Ditto, with content-addressed UUIDv5 ids and an application-layer OR-Set for acceptedBy.
nodes.languageNotes: All collection fields wrapped in List.unmodifiable so two replicas converging on the same set produce bitwise-identical serialization.

nodes.name: StudyNote
nodes.summary: Immutable study note value object; provides UUIDv5-keyed seed/clone factories, fromDittoValue/toDittoDoc round-trip, copyWith, and OR-Set add/remove on acceptedBy.

nodes.name: dql_queries.dart
nodes.summary: Central DQL string constants for the notes collection — subscription, selectAll/byId, upsert with ON ID CONFLICT, and per-row setEmbedding update.

nodes.name: NotesQueries
nodes.summary: Abstract final class holding the canonical DQL strings for the notes collection so schema migrations only need to touch this file.

nodes.name: flashcard_gen.dart
nodes.summary: Builds the Q/A/SOURCE prompt for the on-device LLM and tolerantly parses streaming output back into Flashcards — absorbs Qwen 2.5 quirks like markdown emphasis, <think> blocks, fullwidth punctuation, and mid-stream truncation.
nodes.languageNotes: The label regex includes CJK fullwidth punctuation because Qwen 2.5 sometimes drifts into fullwidth colons mid-generation.

nodes.name: FlashcardGenPrompt
nodes.summary: Static facade exposing build (assembles system + user ChatMessages) and parse (line-walks Q/A/SOURCE labels into Flashcards) with full small-model tolerance.

nodes.name: build
nodes.summary: Assembles the system + user ChatMessage pair for a flashcard generation call, including up to three up-rated few-shot exemplars.

nodes.name: parse
nodes.summary: Tolerant line-walking parser that strips <think> blocks then accumulates Q/A/SOURCE sections with multi-line continuation; drops incomplete trailing cards on truncation.

nodes.name: cactus_service.dart
nodes.summary: Singleton wrapping two CactusLM instances (qwen3-1.7 completion + qwen3-0.6 embedding); handles staged download/initialize with progress callbacks and gates completions with default LaTeX stop sequences.
nodes.languageNotes: Stop sequences are pinned at the service layer (structural gate) rather than detected at parse — see feedback_structural_gates.

nodes.name: CactusService
nodes.summary: Singleton facade over CactusLM completion + embedding; exposes initialize, embed/embedF32, and complete/completeAll streams with CompletionMode.local pinned for the no-cloud invariant.

nodes.name: initialize
nodes.summary: Idempotently downloads and initializes the completion and embedding model contexts, marking cold-load timer phases and forwarding progress to the BootScreen.

nodes.name: embed
nodes.summary: Embeds a non-empty text string via the qwen3-0.6 head and records the embedding dimension for downstream mid-corpus-model-swap guards.

nodes.name: complete
nodes.summary: Streams a completion for the given messages with CompletionMode.local pinned and default LaTeX stop sequences merged with caller-supplied ones.

nodes.name: ditto_service.dart
nodes.summary: Singleton owning the Ditto instance; wires BLE + LAN + AWDL transports in small-peers-only mode, exposes typed CRUD over StudyNote, and broadcasts remote-peer counts for the mesh-status pill.

nodes.name: DittoService
nodes.summary: Singleton facade over the Ditto instance with initialize/startSync, typed upsertNote/queryAll/queryWithEmbedding/setEmbedding, peer-count broadcast, and a live notes observer.

nodes.name: initialize
nodes.summary: Validates DITTO_APP_ID/LICENSE env vars, opens Ditto in small-peers-only mode, configures BLE/LAN/AWDL transports, and registers the presence observer.

nodes.name: queryAll
nodes.summary: Materializes the full notes collection as typed StudyNotes via SELECT * FROM notes.

nodes.name: subscribeToNotes
nodes.summary: Registers a StoreObserver that forwards parsed StudyNote lists to the caller for live UI updates on the notes tab.

nodes.name: retrieval_service.dart
nodes.summary: Singleton owning the retrieval hot path: ensureEmbeddings backfill, cosine top-k with deterministic tie-break, entity-mention grounding gate, and the generateFlashcards event stream that drives Stage 1 UI.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure-math helpers (normalize, dot, rankTopK) are static + visibleForTesting so determinism (R2) can be re-asserted at the unit level.

nodes.name: RetrievedNote
nodes.summary: Lightweight ranked-result wrapper carrying a StudyNote and its cosine score.

nodes.name: Flashcard
nodes.summary: Immutable Q/A flashcard with sourceNoteIds attribution — the contract shared by the generator and the swipeable card UI.

nodes.name: FlashcardEvent
nodes.summary: Sealed event hierarchy for the generateFlashcards stream: Retrieved, Partial, Cards, Done — enforces switch exhaustiveness at every call site.

nodes.name: RetrievalService
nodes.summary: Singleton coordinating ensureEmbeddings, embedQuery title-casing, brute-force cosine topK with minScore + entity-mention gates, and the generateFlashcards event-stream pipeline with cleanCards post-processing.

nodes.name: mentionsEntity
nodes.summary: Substring grounding check: returns true iff the topic appears (case-insensitively) anywhere in the note's topic/body/tags.

nodes.name: backfillCardSources
nodes.summary: Repairs missing SOURCE attribution on cards by either single-retrieval assignment or content-matching against retrieved note topics.

nodes.name: cleanCards
nodes.summary: Six-stage post-parse cleanup: on-topic, reasoning-leak, answer-length, citations-required, dedupe, cap-at-N — each stage absorbs a documented small-model failure mode.

nodes.name: ensureEmbeddings
nodes.summary: Idempotent backfill loop that embeds every note whose embedding column is empty, calling onProgress per-note for the BootScreen subLabel.

nodes.name: topK
nodes.summary: Embeds the query, materializes the corpus, runs brute-force cosine ranking with minScore + dimension guard, and emits a diagnostic logcat shape in debug builds.

nodes.name: rankTopK
nodes.summary: Pure-math cosine ranker with (score desc, _id asc) tie-break — UUIDv5 lex-stable so two devices produce bitwise-identical orderings.

nodes.name: generateFlashcards
nodes.summary: Async generator that runs topK + entity gate, short-circuits to empty when retrieval is empty (grounding gate), builds the prompt, streams Cactus chunks, and emits parsed/attributed/cleaned cards before Done.

nodes.name: seed_loader.dart
nodes.summary: Reads the per-role seed_notes_<role>.json asset and idempotently upserts each entry via DittoService; pre-baked embeddings are passed through verbatim to skip the cold-load backfill.

nodes.name: SeedLoader
nodes.summary: Singleton that exposes role/assetPath/selfContributor accessors plus loadAndInsert (asset → parseSeedJson → upsert loop) and the pure-function parseSeedJson helper.

nodes.name: loadAndInsert
nodes.summary: Loads the role-specific seed asset, parses it to StudyNotes, and upserts each via DittoService — re-runs are no-ops by UUIDv5 + ON ID CONFLICT.

nodes.name: parseSeedJson
nodes.summary: Pure JSON-to-StudyNote parser with optional pre-baked embeddings and strict required-field validation — testable without a Flutter binding.

nodes.name: demo_overlay.dart
nodes.summary: Top-right demonstrator HUD showing peer count, note count, and last-query latency; gated by --dart-define=DEMO_OVERLAY=true and renders SizedBox.shrink() otherwise.

nodes.name: DemoOverlay
nodes.summary: Stack-positioned overlay widget for the demonstrator-side HUD; renders peer/note/latency lines in monospace when the dart-define flag is on.

nodes.name: flashcards_tab.dart
nodes.summary: Topic input → streaming flashcard generation → swipeable card stack UI; consumes a Stream<FlashcardEvent>, persists generation history, and feeds up-rated cards back as few-shot exemplars.
nodes.languageNotes: Largest UI file in the project (876 lines) with multiple private widget classes including TopicInputBar, GeneratingIndicator, GenerationBlock, and the per-card flip animation.

nodes.name: FlashcardsTab
nodes.summary: Stateful widget that owns the topic field, the active FlashcardEvent subscription, generation history, and the up-rated exemplar pool.

nodes.name: mesh_status_widget.dart
nodes.summary: AppBar trailing pill that surfaces mesh-alone vs N-peers state to the audience — gray → green color flip is the visual signal, no pulse animation.

nodes.name: MeshStatusWidget
nodes.summary: Stateful pill that subscribes to a peerCount stream and re-paints with semantic label and camera-legible monospace styling.

nodes.name: notes_tab.dart
nodes.summary: Live notes ListView grouped by contributor (self-first), with long-press accept-peer-note that writes through the OR-Set on the underlying StudyNote.

nodes.name: NotesTab
nodes.summary: Stateful widget subscribing to a notes stream; renders a contributor-grouped ListView with the self group pinned first.

nodes.name: query_screen.dart
nodes.summary: Two-tab Scaffold (Notes + Flashcards) in an IndexedStack with the mesh-status pill in the AppBar; the only place that reaches into the singleton DittoService and RetrievalService.

nodes.name: QueryScreen
nodes.summary: Live UI screen wiring DittoService observers, the peer-count stream, and the FlashcardsTab generation callback into a Scaffold with bottom navigation.

nodes.name: pubspec.yaml
nodes.summary: Flutter package manifest pinning the cactus, ditto_live, uuid, path_provider, and permission_handler dependencies plus declaring the seed asset bundle.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Project overview for the Ditto × Cactus Mesh RAG demo — explains the thesis, how to run it, the boot-to-query architecture, small-model quirks the pipeline absorbs, and the original 4-framing brainstorm.

nodes.name: boot_screen_test.dart
nodes.summary: Smoke test asserting MeshRagApp builds and that an empty PHONE_ROLE surfaces a StateError in the failed-view instead of crashing or silently advancing.

nodes.name: flashcard_gen_test.dart
nodes.summary: Unit tests covering FlashcardGenPrompt.build/parse plus the post-processing pipeline (cleanCards, backfillCardSources) — pins prompt verbatim and all documented small-model quirks.

nodes.name: cold_load_timer_test.dart
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the ColdLoadTimer (Holdout 5) instrument — start/mark/report behavior and report-shape stability.

nodes.name: idempotence_check_test.dart
nodes.summary: Unit tests for IdempotenceCheck (R3 + R4) — exercises convergence, divergence, idempotence happy/sad paths, and top-k drift counting.

nodes.name: retrieval_service_test.dart
nodes.summary: Large unit test suite covering RetrievalService pure-math (normalize, dot, rankTopK) plus grounding gates, source backfill, and the cleanCards pipeline.

nodes.name: seed_loader_test.dart

tour.title: The Thesis: Mesh RAG
tour.description: Start at the README, which frames the project: two phones each hold a slice of a study-notes corpus, meet over BLE/Wi-Fi, and merge their vector indexes as a CRDT so a query on phone A draws on phone B's notes after handshake — with WAN off. CLAUDE.md sits alongside it as the agent-facing playbook and pins the thesis-bearing constraints (cloud is not in the trust boundary, iOS + Android both required, Holdout 7 never cut, determinism is the pre-flight gate). Reading these two together gives you the project's purpose and its red lines before you touch any code.

tour.title: Idea and Validation Harness
tour.description: IDEA-A.md is the load-bearing argument — 'Your knowledge base wants to be a CRDT' — and pins Mesh RAG as the chosen framing out of the four brainstorm options. SEED.md is its operational counterpart: it defines holdouts R1 through R11 (the named scenarios the demo must pass), the cut order under pressure, and the threat-model bound. The thesis-framings memo (a stress test of the candidate framings) shows how the team picked which story to lead with. These three documents establish the vocabulary — R-numbers, holdout cut order, thesis arc — that every later step will reference.

tour.title: The Implementation Plan and Architecture Model
tour.description: The plan at `_docs/plans/001-feat-mesh-rag-demo.md` is the authoritative implementation document — it defines U1..U14 implementation units, maps each to the holdouts it covers, and cites the 281-source research index by per-source ID. The Likec4 model at `docs/c4/model.c4` is its visual sibling: it declares the four containers (phone_app, cactus_models, ditto_store, determinism_harness) and the component-level relationships you will encounter as code in the next steps. Reading these now means every file you open later has a place to land in the U-numbered plan and the C4 hierarchy.

tour.title: Application Boot Path
tour.description: `lib/main.dart` is the entry point — and the highest-fan-out file in the lib/ tree. It runs cold-load instrumentation, requests mesh permissions, and drives the BootScreen state machine through four named phases: Ditto initialize, SeedLoader parse, Cactus initialize, and embedding backfill — then swaps in QueryScreen. This file is the bird's-eye view: every service you meet in the next four steps gets wired up here in the order the demo needs them.
tour.languageLesson: Dart's `async`/`await` reads sequentially but does not block the UI isolate. The BootScreen uses a state-machine pattern (an enum of phases plus setState) rather than chained Futures so the UI can report progress at named boundaries — important when a model download phase can take tens of seconds on a cold device.

tour.title: Domain Model: The CRDT Row
tour.description: `lib/models/study_note.dart` defines StudyNote — the canonical row synced by Ditto. It uses content-addressed UUIDv5 ids (so two phones that ingest the same content produce the same key) and an application-layer OR-Set for `acceptedBy`, layered on top of Ditto's grow-only G-Set semantics. Alongside it, `lib/prompts/dql_queries.dart` is the small but central file of DQL string constants — subscription, selectAll/byId, upsert with ON ID CONFLICT, and per-row setEmbedding — that every higher layer reuses. StudyNote is the highest fan-in node in the codebase (13 dependents), so understanding its shape unlocks every later step.
tour.languageLesson: Content-addressed UUIDv5 ids let two devices independently produce the same id for the same content, which is what makes the union of two corpora idempotent. Combined with Ditto's grow-only set semantics, this is what lets the vector index merge correctly without coordination — the core CRDT-shaped move the whole writeup hinges on.

tour.title: Sync Layer: Ditto over BLE / LAN
tour.description: `lib/services/ditto_service.dart` is the singleton that owns the Ditto instance — it wires up BLE + LAN + AWDL transports in small-peers-only mode, exposes typed CRUD over StudyNote, and broadcasts the remote-peer count that drives the mesh-status pill in Step 9. `lib/services/seed_loader.dart` is its boot-time partner: it reads the per-role `seed_notes_<role>.json` asset (audience-submitted study notes, not recipes) and idempotently upserts each entry via DittoService, passing pre-baked embeddings through verbatim to skip the cold-load backfill. Together they implement the 'phones meet over BLE' half of the thesis from Step 1.

tour.title: On-Device AI Runtime
tour.description: `lib/services/cactus_service.dart` wraps two CactusLM instances — qwen3-1.7 for completion and qwen3-0.6 for embedding — and handles their staged download and initialize with progress callbacks. This is the layer that has to stay on-device with no cloud fallback (the thesis-bearing constraint from Step 1). The companion document `_docs/notes/cactus-sdk-quirks.md` catalogues the Cactus 1.3.0 Flutter SDK behaviors the demo had to work around, most famously a Supabase telemetry call that pierced airplane mode — engineering evidence for why grounding has to be structural and not just configured.

tour.title: Retrieval and Generation Hot Path
tour.description: `lib/services/retrieval_service.dart` is where the math from Step 5 meets the model from Step 7: it owns the embedding-backfill, the cosine top-k with deterministic tie-break, the entity-mention grounding gate, and the `generateFlashcards` event stream that the UI consumes. `lib/prompts/flashcard_gen.dart` builds the Q/A/SOURCE prompt and tolerantly parses streaming output back into Flashcards — absorbing Qwen 2.5 quirks like markdown emphasis, `<think>` blocks, fullwidth punctuation, and mid-stream truncation. This pair is the project's core feature: retrieve from the merged corpus, then generate grounded flashcards.
tour.languageLesson: Dart `Stream<FlashcardEvent>` lets the service emit incremental events as the on-device LLM streams tokens, so the UI can show partial cards as they arrive. The grounding gate runs before generation rather than detecting bad output after the fact — a structural service-layer gate, not a stream-watching heuristic, which is the project's lesson learned about small-model behavior.

tour.title: UI Surfaces: Query, Notes, Flashcards, Mesh Pill
tour.description: `lib/widgets/query_screen.dart` is the two-tab Scaffold (Notes + Flashcards in an IndexedStack) and the only place that reaches into the singleton DittoService and RetrievalService from Steps 6 and 8. `flashcards_tab.dart` consumes the `Stream<FlashcardEvent>` from Step 8 and renders the swipeable card stack; `notes_tab.dart` shows a live ListView grouped by contributor and supports long-press accept-peer-note (writing through the OR-Set on StudyNote from Step 5); `mesh_status_widget.dart` is the AppBar pill that flips gray-to-green when peers appear — the visible audience signal that the mesh is alive.

tour.title: Holdouts: The Validation Instruments
tour.description: These are the in-app and out-of-app instruments that prove the holdouts from Step 2 actually hold. `cold_load_timer.dart` (R5) records elapsed milliseconds at named boot-phase boundaries and emits a JSON report against the 10-second app-launch budget. `idempotence_check.dart` is the pure-function snapshot diff for R3 (sync idempotence) and R4 (bidirectional CRDT merge), and `tools/holdout_34/verdict.dart` is the Dart CLI that consumes those snapshots and emits a PASS/FAIL verdict. The determinism harness at `tools/determinism_harness/integration_test/measure_test.dart` is the R2 pre-flight gate — it embeds fixture queries on iOS and Android and writes per-device JSON so cross-platform cosine parity can be checked exactly.

tour.title: Tests That Pin the Math and the Quirks
tour.description: `test/retrieval_service_test.dart` is the large suite that pins the pure math of RetrievalService — normalize, dot, rankTopK — plus the grounding gates, SOURCE backfill, and the cleanCards pipeline. `test/flashcard_gen_test.dart` pins the prompt verbatim and exercises every documented small-model quirk against the parser. `_docs/notes/model-quirks.md` is the prose companion: a running catalogue of Qwen 2.5 1.7B behaviors (bilingual chain-of-thought drift, fabrication, grounding-prompt rationalization) that the parser had to absorb — and that the writeup uses as evidence for the specialists-vs-generalists thread.

tour.title: Build, CI, and Demo Day
tour.description: `justfile` is the task-runner manifest centralizing every repo workflow — C4 dashboard build, determinism harness, mesh_rag app runs per phone role, holdout 3/4/7 runners, Ditto wipe, demo-overlay flags, and the seed-embedding bake/pull cycle. `.github/workflows/ci.yml` runs `just ci` (flutter analyze + test) on push and PR, pinning Flutter 3.32.0 so CI-green and local-green are the same set of checks. `pubspec.yaml` pins the cactus + ditto_live + permission_handler dependencies and the seed asset bundle. `_docs/demo-script.md` closes the loop: a rehearsable beat-by-beat narration for the Holdout 1 airplane-mode demo — the moment all of the above gets shown to a live audience.
tour.languageLesson: A justfile (just is the task runner) plays the role a Makefile would in a C project but without tab-sensitivity and with `set dotenv-load` for environment ergonomics. Pairing it with a GitHub Actions workflow that just calls `just ci` keeps the CI green path and the local green path bitwise the same — no drift between what runs on your laptop and what runs on the runner.
